title: Komşu

characters.WOMAN: a young woman of about twenty-eight with short curly red hair, wearing a teal knitted sweater
characters.NEIGHBOR: an elderly woman with grey hair in a bun and round glasses, wearing a long green cardigan

scenes.text:
Yıllardır aynı duvarı paylaştığın komşunun
adını biliyor musun?
scenes.prompt: In a quiet apartment stairwell on an autumn evening, {WOMAN} stands in front of her own door and looks thoughtfully at the closed door next to hers, a warm lamp glowing on the landing.

scenes.text:
Eskiden kapıdan bir tabak gelirdi,
asla boş geri dönmezdi.
scenes.prompt: A covered plate of homemade cookies sits on a doormat in front of a wooden apartment door, a warm lamp glowing above, autumn leaves blown in through an open stairwell window.

scenes.text:
Şimdi merdivende bile
göz göze gelmiyoruz.
scenes.prompt: In an apartment stairwell, {WOMAN} on the left walks up the stairs looking down, {NEIGHBOR} on the right walks down the stairs looking down, they pass without looking at each other, rain on the stairwell window.

scenes.text:
Oysa zor bir gecede
kapını ilk çalan, komşun olur.
scenes.prompt: During a power cut on a rainy night, {NEIGHBOR} stands in the open doorway on the right with a glowing lantern, {WOMAN} on the left looks relieved and grateful, warm golden light on their faces.

scenes.text:
Bu akşam bir tabakla kapısını çal.
Bunu apartman grubuna gönder.
scenes.prompt: On a warm lamp-lit apartment landing, {WOMAN} on the left and {NEIGHBOR} on the right laugh together in an open doorway, a plate of cookies on a small table beside the door, autumn leaves outside the window.

caption:
Komşunu tanıyor musun?

Bir tabak, bir kapı, bir merhaba; eksik olan sadece bu. 🤍

Bunu apartman grubuna gönder.
